messages:
Rhea: FYI bringing rank-v2-int8 (post-PTQ) into canary. quick offline shows strange MRR hit that clusters on queries ending with punctuation or emoji. posting sample metrics + notes.

EvalBot: offline compare rank-v2-int8 -> baseline float32
EvalBot: NDCG@10: 0.804 -> 0.800 (-0.004)
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.658 -> 0.620 (-0.038)  <-- top of tail is fine, most drop in short queries with trailing punctuation/emoji

Tom: that smells like tokenizer boundary + quant sensitive tokens. do we have examples?

Rhea: samples that lost top1:
Rhea: "best ramen near me?" (question mark tokenized separately)
Rhea: "how long until shipping \r\n" (stray newline CRLF sequences)
Rhea: "open-source libs for graphs " (control char showing up in raw capture)
Rhea: "what's the weather \r\n"); (emoji+weird bytes)

Ibrahim: first pass: normalize unicode (NFKC), strip control chars (\u0000-\u001f), collapse repeated punctuation. rerun token diff raw vs cleaned on a 1k sample of failing queries.

Tom: also verify training ingest did same normalizations; if training saw cleaned text and eval got raw, we get boundary mismatch.

EvalBot: quick re-eval with NFKC + remove-control normalized queries:
EvalBot: NDCG@10: 0.804 -> 0.802
EvalBot: MRR@10: 0.658 -> 0.640
EvalBot: (MRR gap reduced to -0.018)

Rhea: normalization explains ~half. residual could be quant kernel sensitivity; plan: run per-channel int8 vs per-tensor and an alternate PTQ config (outlier-clipping enabled).

Ibrahim: I'll spin the kernel ablation tomorrow. command i use for parity runs:
Ibrahim: python eval/run_compare.py --model rank-v2-int8 --baseline rank-v2-fp32 --slice trailing_punct_emoji --limit 15000 --out s3://evals/rank-v2/ablation.csv.gz

Tom: minor infra request: include a hex field of raw bytes and a normalized_text field in the eval CSV. our UI masks invisible chars so this will help triage.

Rhea: agreed. i'll open a tiny change to infra to add raw_hex and norm_flag to CSV schema. also adding --apply-normalize boolean to harness so we can reproduce both variants.

DeployBot: canary deployed: rank-v2-int8 -> canary (tag: canary-2026-04-01-rankv2)

Ibrahim: once per-channel ablation completes i'll drop diffs and tokenization mismatch stats. if kernel change doesn't close residual, next step is to force serve-side normalization for a short-term mitigation.

Rhea: timeline: PR for CSV fields + normalize flag (today), ablation runs (tomorrow), 100k cleaned vs raw eval (Thu), decision by EOD Fri. tagging @Tom for tokenizer test additions.

Tom: will add a unit test to assert ingest pipeline normalization parity with eval harness. also will add a tiny benchmark to show token boundary shifts for common punctuation/emoji sequences.

Rhea: thanks team. i'll post the eval CSV links in #eng-ml when ready and create a ticket with representative failing pairs so we don't lose them.

Ibrahim: uploading preliminary ablation outputs now. will share pointer shortly.

Rhea: closing for now, feel free to DM if you want to inspect specific failing examples. :thumbsup:
